title: Leaning on the Everlasting Arms
description: Leaning on the Everlasting Arms in Tonic Solfa to SHOWALTER: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the three verses and the refrain, and a piano.
about: Elisha A. Hoffman wrote the verses and Anthony J. Showalter the refrain and the tune; the song was published in 1887.
underlay: What a fel-low-ship, what a joy di-vine, Lean-ing on the ev-er-last-ing arms; What a bless-ed-ness, what a peace is mine, Lean-ing on the ev-er-last-ing arms. Lean-ing, lean-ing, Safe and se-cure from all a-larms; Lean-ing, lean-ing, Lean-ing on the ev-er-last-ing arms.

lines: What a fellowship, what a joy divine,
What a blessedness, what a peace is mine,

verses.label: Refrain
lines: Safe and secure from all alarms;
O how sweet to walk in this pilgrim way,
O how bright the path grows from day to day,
What have I to dread, what have I to fear,
I have blessed peace with my Lord so near,
